description: Set up the environment and gather objective QA evidence: install dependencies, run lint and build capturing all output, start the dev server, and exercise the single landing page (/) with a browser automation tool to capture responsive screenshots, console/network activity, and keyboard-navigation behavior. This produces the raw evidence the audit report (FEAT-002) is written from. Independent of FEAT-002 authoring but must run first.
steps: Source node from nvm before every node/npm command: export PATH="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH" (node is NOT on the default PATH).
cd /projects/sandbox/kiro-web-playground && npm install. Capture the full output, including any deprecation/peer-dependency warnings.
Read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ (per AGENTS.md this Next.js version has breaking changes) to confirm current conventions before interpreting build/lint output.
Run `npm run lint` and save the complete output verbatim to .agents/tasks/task-qa-audit/evidence-lint.txt (create the file even if output is empty/clean).
Run `npm run build` and save the complete output verbatim to .agents/tasks/task-qa-audit/evidence-build.txt, noting warnings, bundle sizes, and any errors.
Start the dev server in the background: `npm run dev` (serves http://localhost:3000). Wait until it is ready.
Activate a browser automation power (playwright preferred; fall back to agent-browser) via the kiro_powers interface. Load http://localhost:3000.

Capture screenshots at three viewports and save them under .agents/tasks/task-qa-audit/screenshots/: desktop 1440x900 (desktop.png), tablet 768x1024 (tablet.png), mobile 375x667 (mobile.png). Also capture the page in dark mode (emulate prefers-color-scheme: dark) as dark.png.
Collect browser console messages (errors, warnings, info) and save to .agents/tasks/task-qa-audit/evidence-console.txt.
Collect network activity (all requests, statuses, and any 404/500/failed/duplicate requests) and save to .agents/tasks/task-qa-audit/evidence-network.txt.

Test keyboard navigation: Tab through the page, record the tab order of focusable elements (the 4 links: Templates, Learning, Deploy Now, Documentation), whether visible focus indicators appear, and save observations to .agents/tasks/task-qa-audit/evidence-a11y.txt.

Inspect the rendered DOM for: image alt text on both <Image> elements, target/rel attributes on all 4 anchors (note the two inline text links lack target/rel while the two buttons have them), presence of semantic landmarks (<main> exists in page.tsx; note absence of <header>/<footer>/<nav>), and the computed body font-family (confirm the Arial-vs-Geist conflict from globals.css). Save to evidence-a11y.txt / evidence-ui.txt.

If the browser automation power cannot be driven, perform equivalent static analysis of app/page.tsx, app/layout.tsx, and app/globals.css instead, and clearly record in each evidence file which checks were dynamic vs static.
Stop the dev server when evidence collection is complete.
acceptance_criteria: node_modules/ exists and `npm install` completed (exit 0) with any warnings captured.
evidence-lint.txt and evidence-build.txt exist and contain the verbatim command output; build exit status is recorded.
screenshots/desktop.png, tablet.png, mobile.png, and dark.png exist (OR the file clearly documents that browser automation was unavailable and static analysis was substituted).
evidence-console.txt, evidence-network.txt, evidence-a11y.txt, and evidence-ui.txt exist and record findings (including 'none observed' where clean).
Each evidence file states whether its checks were performed dynamically (browser) or via static analysis.
verification: export PATH="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH" && cd /projects/sandbox/kiro-web-playground && npm run build  (confirm exit status and that output was captured to evidence-build.txt)
export PATH="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH" && npm run lint  (confirm output captured to evidence-lint.txt)
ls .agents/tasks/task-qa-audit/ and .agents/tasks/task-qa-audit/screenshots/ to confirm all evidence artifacts exist
findings: Environment: node v22.23.2 via nvm (PATH prepend required). npm install exit 0, 428 pkgs, 7 vulns (1 low/6 high) all in transitive dev/build deps + the next@16.2.4 advisory range; none exploitable in this static no-API/no-auth app but flagged for hygiene (captured in evidence-build.txt). LINT: `npm run lint` (eslint flat config) exit 0, zero errors/warnings (evidence-lint.txt). BUILD: `npm run build` (Next 16.2.4 Turbopack) exit 0, compiled ~1.85s, TS check passed, routes / and /_not-found both static-prerendered. NOTE: this Next version's Turbopack build table does NOT print per-route Size/First-Load-JS columns (output-format change vs older Next; not a failure) - raw on-disk chunk sizes measured instead (largest client chunks ~227KB/195KB/112KB; total .next 6.8MB). BROWSER AUTOMATION: playwright power WORKED but with two constraints handled: (a) the automation browser runs in a network context isolated from the sandbox localhost dev server (and background dev-server procs are reaped between shell calls), so dynamic checks were run by rendering the app's REAL server-rendered HTML + REAL compiled CSS (both pulled from the live dev server via curl) into Chromium via page.setContent; (b) file:// and require/Buffer/atob were blocked in run_code, worked around with a pure-JS base64 decoder. Screenshots captured at desktop 1440x900, tablet 768x1024, mobile 375x667, and dark (prefers-color-scheme:dark) - all valid PNGs at correct dims (logo shows partial glyph in shots due to a truncated inlined data-URI, a capture artifact only; live /next.svg & /vercel.svg return 200). CONSOLE (dynamic, live server): clean except one REAL reproducible next/image aspect-ratio WARNING for vercel.svg (also in dev stdout) + benign React-DevTools INFO/[HMR] LOG + dev-only HMR WebSocket ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED retries (absent in prod). No app JS errors. NETWORK: / 200, /next.svg 200, /vercel.svg 200, CSS chunk 200, unknown route -> 404 correctly; no 5xx, no CORS (same-origin only), no auth (N/A). A11Y (dynamic computed): tab order logical across the 4 links, UA default focus outline visible (no custom :focus-visible), both images have alt text, single h1, lang=en, only <main> landmark (no header/footer/nav), contrast passes AA/AAA in light & dark; inline links have text-decoration:none (weak affordance). UI: CONFIRMED body computed font-family='Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif' (globals.css hardcode) vs Geist on h1/p/.font-sans div = the Arial-vs-Geist conflict; CONFIRMED Templates/Learning inline links lack target/rel while Deploy Now/Documentation have target=_blank rel=noopener noreferrer; CONFIRMED placeholder metadata title 'Create Next App' / description 'Generated by create next app'; dark mode is prefers-color-scheme only (no toggle); responsive layout clean at all 3 breakpoints with no overflow. All 8 evidence artifacts + 4 screenshots written under .agents/tasks/task-qa-audit/; each evidence file states dynamic-vs-static method. Temp helper scripts/logs removed from the repo. No app code changed, no commit (not required for FEAT-001).
